test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The old port was **__abandoned__** a long ago.
solution: The correct answer is **"Kept."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined word is **"abandoned,"** which means left behind or deserted, to leave somebody/something that you are responsible for, usually permanently. (किसी प्राणी या वस्‍तु को, जिस का उत्तरदायित्‍व आप पर है, प्रायः सदा के लिए छोड़ देना) • **Example:** *The bank robbers **abandoned**__ the car just outside the city.* • **"Kept"** means to hold or retain something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को विशेष स्थिति, स्‍थान या दशा में बनाए रखना) __ • **Example:** *She **kept**__ the door open.* • Therefore, the correct antonym of **"abandoned"** is **"kept."** • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Quit** means to stop doing something, which is not the opposite of abandoned. (कुछ करना बंद कर देना या छोड़ देना) • **Shortened** means to make something shorter or reduce its length, which is not the opposite of abandoned. (छोटा हो जाना या कर देना) • **Rashed** is not a word in English and does not make sense in this context. 1b2:T103e, The correct answer is **"distribution."**
